nextcloud_url.description: Base URL of your Nextcloud instance (must include scheme, e.g., https://).

nextcloud_app_password.description: App password for authentication (created in Nextcloud Admin → Security → App passwords). Do not use your account password.

nextcloud_user.description: Username of a Nextcloud user with monitoring permissions (typically admin or a dedicated service account).

nextcloud_skip_tls.description: Set to true to skip TLS certificate verification (only for self-signed certificates during testing).

listen_address.description: Network interface and port the exporter listens on for incoming Prometheus scrapes.

metrics_path.description: HTTP path where metrics are exposed (e.g., /metrics). Must be accessible to Prometheus.

scrape_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for Nextcloud API responses before timing out a scrape.

debug.description: Enable verbose logging (e.g., for debugging connection or parsing issues).

items.description: Additional Nextcloud metrics groups to collect beyond the core ones. Choose from: activity, files, quota, shares, system, users, mail.

nextcloud_extra_metrics.description: List of extra metrics categories to expose (e.g., ['activity', 'quota']). See exporter docs for details.
